classification.difficultyReason: Identify the y-intercept, calculate another point and sketch each straight line.

content.prompt: Sketch the graph of each of the following lines by using the $y$-intercept and finding another point.

answer.worked:
When $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=4(0)-3\\y&=-3\end{align*}$$
When $x=1$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=4(1)-3\\y&=1\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,-3)$ and $(1,1)$, then draw the straight line through them.

When $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=5-6(0)\\y&=5\end{align*}$$
When $x=1$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=5-6(1)\\y&=-1\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,5)$ and $(1,-1)$, then draw the straight line through them.

When $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=\frac{1}{3}(0)+2\\y&=2\end{align*}$$
When $x=1$:
$$\begin{align*}y&=\frac{1}{3}(1)+2\\y&=\frac{7}{3}\end{align*}$$
Plot $(0,2)$ and $\left(1,\frac{7}{3}\right)$, then draw the straight line through them.
